name: cecasem-helpdesk
description: Mesa de Ayuda CECASEM - monorepo local

scripts.db:prepare: npm run prisma:generate --workspace backend && npm run prisma:deploy --workspace backend && npm run prisma:seed --workspace backend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names API,WEB --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
